name: survey-creator-collaboration
description: Collaborative Survey Creator editing built on the journal plugin. The Node server is a reference implementation of the language-agnostic protocol (see PROTOCOL.md).

scripts.install:clients: npm --prefix lobby install && npm --prefix clients/react install && npm --prefix clients/vue install && npm --prefix clients/js install && npm --prefix clients/angular install
scripts.build:clients: npm run build:lobby && npm run build:react && npm run build:vue && npm run build:js && npm run build:angular
scripts.start: npm run build:clients && npm run server
